summary: Gone two-story log cabin lookout on the Bitterroot NF: approved in 1934, destroyed 1960; no source describes the site today beyond a hike-in label.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1960 per all three pages read

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in

events.note: Two-story log cabin. A March 29, 1934 Ravalli Republic item, as quoted by Forest Lookouts, reported a tower and lookout as tentatively approved

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: 1934 two-story log cabin on Idaho Fire Lookouts
Bitterroot National Forest on Idaho Fire Lookouts
1934 item: tower and lookout tentatively approved in the Salmon forest
evidence.quote: Projects tentatively approved are the building of a tower and lookout at Squaretop in the Salmon forest.

evidence.supports: 1934 two-story log cabin, per Forest Lookouts
March 29, 1934 date of the Ravalli Republic item
Bitterroot National Forest on Forest Lookouts page

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1934 newspaper item, as quoted by Forest Lookouts, names the Salmon forest; the three pages read list the Bitterroot National Forest. The record uses Bitterroot.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no staffing, no fire history, no photos, and no description of the site after 1960. The 1934 approval is known only through Forest Lookouts' quote of a Ravalli Republic item; the paper itself was not read. Forest and tower-versus-cabin wording differs between the 1934 item and later pages.
